Package org.thewhitemage13.logging

Class LoggingAspect

java.lang.Object
org.thewhitemage13.logging.LoggingAspect
@Component public class LoggingAspect extends Object
Aspect for logging method calls, results, and exceptions in the application.

This class uses Aspect-Oriented Programming (AOP) to log various aspects of method execution, including method entry, successful execution, and exception handling. The logging is done using SLF4J and logs method signatures, arguments, return values, and any exceptions thrown.

Key Features:

  • Logs method entry with method name and arguments.
  • Logs successful execution with method name and result.
  • Logs exceptions thrown during method execution with method name and error message.
  • Uses SLF4J for logging, which can be configured for various logging frameworks (e.g., Logback, Log4j).

Usage:

This aspect is automatically applied to all methods in the package `org.thewhitemage13` and its sub-packages using the Before, AfterReturning, AfterThrowing, and Around annotations. It logs method executions at different stages to help trace method behavior, performance, and error tracking.

    • logAfterMethod

      public void logAfterMethod(org.aspectj.lang.JoinPoint joinPoint, Object result)
      Logs the method result after it successfully completes.

    • logAfterThrowing

      public void logAfterThrowing(org.aspectj.lang.JoinPoint joinPoint, Exception exception)

    • logAroundMethod

      public Object logAroundMethod(org.aspectj.lang.ProceedingJoinPoint joinPoint) throws Throwable
      Logs the method execution flow, including entry, execution, and result.

      Parameters:

      the result returned by the target method
